# Parts

## Variables floe sets

| Variable | Set in | What it is | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--floe-room` | The page's root | The room between parts (`0px` on paper) | `0.75rem` |
| `--floe-copy-size` | The page's root | The copy button's size | `30px` |
| `--floe-copy-room` | The page's root | The room for the button | `calc(var(--floe-copy-size) + 2 * var(--floe-copy-gap))` |
| `--floe-inset` | A box's file | A shadow within | `0 0 #0000` |
| `--tone` | An element with a tone | The tone's colour | — |

## Code's look

| Variable | Set in | What it is | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--floe-code-pad` | `code`'s root | The room at a line's sides | `1.1rem` |
| `--floe-code-room` | `code`'s root | The room after a line | `var(--floe-code-pad)` |
